title: Expiry, Suspension and Closure of Northgate Memberships
content:
A membership of Northgate Memberships is always in one of five states: active, expired, suspended, cancelled or closed.

## Expiry

A membership not renewed by the end of its expiry date becomes expired the next day.

## Suspension

When a membership fee payment is charged back by the card issuer, the membership office suspends the membership. Member services cannot lift a suspension; the suspension is lifted by the membership office once the charged-back fee has been repaid at a club membership counter. A suspension not cleared within the tier's suspension period, in calendar days, ends in closure.

## Closure after a lapse

An expired membership is closed only when the current date is later than the tier's closure period, in calendar months, after the expiry date of its last membership year. Calendar months are added to the expiry date and, when the resulting month has no such day, the boundary falls on that month's last day. On the boundary day itself the membership is not yet closed.

| Expiry date of the last year (hypothetical) | Closure period | Boundary day | Closed on the boundary day | Closed the day after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31 March 2026 | 18 months | 30 September 2027 (September has no 31st) | No | Yes |
| 15 May 2026 | 18 months | 15 November 2027 | No | Yes |

## Closed memberships

A closed membership keeps its history but can never be renewed or reopened; the person enrolls again under a new membership number, and any unredeemed certificate of the closed membership is void.

## State changes at a glance

| From | To | Brought about by |
|---|---|---|
| active | expired | the day after the expiry date passes without a renewal fee |
| expired | active | a renewal of the lapsed membership |
| active | suspended | the membership office, after a fee chargeback |
| suspended | active | the membership office, once the charged-back fee is repaid at a club |
| active | cancelled | the primary member's confirmed cancellation |
| expired | closed | the closure period passing |
| suspended | closed | the suspension period passing uncleared |
